Dialogue_Text: You come. We can finally look each other in the eye, my vessel.
Oh great. Another monster. Perhaps we should skip the pleasantries and move right on to the unavoidable fight?
It is most entertaining that you say this. It truly is proof that we are but one thing.
I am your blood. I am every drop of this red tincture that's running through your veins; I am what keeps you alive, and bound with who you truly are, <CHARNAME>. I suppose that makes me... you.
What sort of trick is this?
I suppose that makes sense. I should have expected that the Bloody Pages of Bhaal would be somehow connected to me.
It's simple: the book you just touched has connected to your blood. To me. That is what allows us to speak the way we do right now.
It does make sense, doesn't it? The book has connected to your blood, allowing us to speak the way we do right now.

I know that you were asked to investigate the book, but truth be told, it works both ways. The book is also studying us, showing us the people that shaped our story. You might have seen Alaundo, Sarevok, and the others—including the man that captured you. Experimented on us; on both you and me.
The book is like an eye and a mirror. One that allows those like yourself to learn what they need to learn.
What do I need to learn?
I don't need to learn anything, or at least not from you. I have no interest in being my father's perfect <PRO_SONDAUGHTER>.
And do you think you have a choice?
There are times when you will be given no choice.
